atoms.text:
Mit dem present progressive passive kann man eine in der Gegenwart andauernde Handlung ins Passiv setzen.

Es wird gebildet mit
am/is/are + being + past participle des Verbs.
atoms.sound: Mit dem <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>present progressive passive</voice> kann man eine in der Gegenwart andauernde Handlung ins Passiv setzen. Es wird gebildet mit <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>am, is, are</voice> plus <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>being</voice> plus <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>past participle</voice> des Verbs.

example.a: An image <m-yellow>is being painted</m-yellow> at the moment.
example.sound: An image is being painted at the moment.

atoms.a: Wie wird das present progressive passive gebildet?
atoms.sound: Wie wird das <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>present progressive passive</voice> gebildet?

instruction.text: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im present progressive? Wähle ihn aus.
instruction.sound: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>present progressive</voice> Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++Our plants are being watered by our neighbour while we're on holiday.
Our neighbour is watering our plants while we're on holiday.
Our plants will be watered by our neighbour while we're on holiday.
++Essays are being written by the pupils in the English lesson.
The pupils are going to write essays in the English lesson.
Essays have been written by the pupils in the English lesson.
++The moving boxes are being carried by my parents and me.
The moving boxes had been carried by my parents and me.
My parents and I were carrying the moving boxes.
++The bags are being packed for the camping trip.
The bags had been packed for the camping trip.
I am packing the bags for the camping trip.

instruction.text: Bringe die Teile der Passivkonstruktion in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.b: A board game ((is)) ((being)) ((played)) by her family.
